evidence.evidence_text: Traditional methods only target labeled attributes, ignoring biases from unlabeled ones.
We tackle societal bias in image-text datasets by removing spurious correlations between protected groups and image attributes.
Evaluations on multi-label image classification and image captioning tasks show our method effectively reduces bias without compromising performance across various models.
Using text-guided inpainting models, our approach ensures protected group independence from all attributes and mitigates inpainting biases through data filtering.
